_comment: Terraform directories deliberately NOT PLANNED by any workflow.
This is about the PLAN pipeline only. Every directory here is still LINTED: the
`lint` job in ci-coverage.yaml runs tflint in each one, needs no AWS credentials, and
cannot be opted out of. An entry below therefore means 'no terraform plan/apply runs
for this directory', not 'no CI touches it'.
Read and enforced by .github/scripts/check_terraform_ci_coverage.py: an entry must name
a directory that exists AND is not plan-covered, so an exclusion cannot outlive its
reason. Anything not listed here must be plan-covered.

excluded.reason: Runs terraform against the organization MANAGEMENT account, and the OIDC_ROLE_ARN secret CI holds targets the workload account. Pointing CI at a role with management-account Organizations write access is a separate decision, taken explicitly rather than inherited. See environments/org-delegation/README.md, 'Where it runs'. This excludes PLAN and APPLY only -- tflint still runs here via the credential-free lint job in ci-coverage.yaml, so run terraform fmt -check and validate by hand before changing it, but linting is covered.

Consumed only by environments/org-delegation, which is plan-excluded above for its credential boundary, so no workflow can plan this module either. It IS linted directly by the lint job in ci-coverage.yaml. If this module ever gains a consumer that is plan-covered, delete this entry -- the coverage check will then require it.
